name: com.lask3802.unaudio
description: Low-latency native audio engine for Unity. Plays Ogg Vorbis / MP3 / FLAC / WAV straight from AssetBundles (zero managed copy) with native async decoding, an SSE2/NEON mixer, sample-exact scheduling and a smoothed audible-time clock. Backends: WASAPI, CoreAudio, AAudio/OpenSL ES (Oboe), ALSA.

samples.description: Load an imported UNAudioAsset, play, stop and fade.
Load Ogg / MP3 / FLAC / WAV audio out of an AssetBundle with native async decoding.
Sample-exact scheduling and audible-time judgement for music games.
